text.p: Cantel Industries Inc said on Monday it expected to earn between $0.40 and $0.50 per share for its fiscal year ended July 31, 1997, compared to $0.21 per share for fiscal 1996.
Including one-time costs associated with the company's acquisition of Minnesota-based MediVators Inc, the company earned $0.10 per share in fiscal 1996.
In an interview with Reuters, Cantel said it expected the MediVators acquisition would be $0.10 to $0.20 per share accretive to 1997 earnings.
There was no First Call earnings estimate for the company.

MediVators designs, makes and markets endoscope disinfection equipment and supplies and medical waste disposal systems. Cantel, through its Canadian subsidiary Carsen Group Inc, markets and distributes medical equipment, including flexible and rigid endoscopes, precision instruments and industrial equipment.
MediVators sales would trend between $9 million and $10 million in fiscal 1997, Cantel President and Chief Executive Officer James Reilly told Reuters.
